description: Use when testing container escape during an authorized security assessment, CTF, or lab exercise. Covers in-container reconnaissance (capabilities, mounts, Docker socket, cgroups), privileged container escape, Docker socket abuse, the release_agent cgroup escape, CAP_SYS_ADMIN techniques, and host filesystem access via exposed mounts using Docker 27.x and Python 3.12. Use when you have a shell inside a Docker container and need to determine whether host access is reachable, in your own lab or an in-scope target.
